Cost: LOL
Humanity Loss: 20 (6d6)

Neuralware. Borgware. Requires 3 Neuralware Option Slots and 3 Internal Option Slots.
Duration: 5 rounds (15 seconds)
Primary Effects:
User always starts the round at the top of Initiative.
+6 to Evasion.
Secondary Effects (Limit 3 per Round):
Take an additional Action.
Make an Attack with Advantage.
On the User's turn, move to any space within a 25x25 area centered around the user.
If hit by an Enemy attack, make a single Attack as a Reaction.

Note: Activating the Zenith causes the user to suffer 3d6 Humanity Loss. Using any of the Secondary Effects will cause the user to suffer 2d6 Humanity Loss each time they are used.

Type: Neuralware
Option Slots: uses 3

Foundry notes:

  • Activate it like the core Sandevistan: the Primary Effects are toggles in the roll dialog, on by default, and the Secondary Effects are toggles that start off. Turn on only the ones you use.
  • It also needs 3 Internal Option Slots.
  • Starting at the top of the Initiative order and every Secondary Effect are not automated.
  • The sheet's cost is "LOL", so its price is 0 here.
  • Humanity Loss for activating it and for each Secondary Effect is not automated.
  • The sheet gives no install location, so it uses the core Sandevistan's (Clinic).

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Sandevistans).
